designNotes: ShaderC/SPIR-V source interface: #include, explicit locations, separate-shader-objects extension, and gl_VertexIndex for both Vulkan and OpenGL.
Sky keeps all authored functions, three fog-color activators, cone geometry, and projection inverse. Fog varyings use vanilla locations 0 and 1, with the custom mat4 occupying locations 2 through 5.
Clouds follows the official 26.3 clouds.vsh rename and vertex generation while retaining cloud suppression for all three authored space activators. Vanilla clouds.fsh handles OIT phases.
Ordinary particles use the official 26.3 fragment shader, including OIT alpha-only, transmittance, accumulation, fog, and explicit-depth-invariance behavior.

Marker particles retain the original screen positions and near-plane z=1. Vanilla 26.3 uses reversed depth. Markers write alpha 1 through every OIT phase so opaque depth bounds cull geometry behind the marker and final composite recovers its RGB bytes.

Always-on end_of_frame replaces the removed transparency hook. It uses only minecraft:main, the sole external target exposed by GameRenderer, after world/OIT composition. It preserves the persistent 5 by 4 interpolation data, removes marker pixels, runs the authored shake/alarm/distortion shaders, and blits to main.
No game connection or live Minecraft validation was performed.

offlineEvidence.shaderCompiler: Independent validator: 50 ShaderC stages and 19 stage pairs passed using the exact 26.3 Vulkan1.2 frontend settings, including both depth conventions and OIT variants.
offlineEvidence.markerOit: Official include/oit_depth_bounds.glsl records opaque depth when alpha > 0.99. core/oit_depth_bounds_cull.fsh writes opaque depth into the OIT render target. core/oit_composite.fsh snaps transmittance below0.02 to full coverage and normalizes accumulated color.
offlineEvidence.postTiming: GameRenderer requests END_OF_FRAME_POST_EFFECT before player effects, applies chains with LevelTargetBundle.MAIN_TARGETS, and existing InternalTarget codec retains width, height, persistent, clear_color.
